product_metadata.title: FIREFLY Kosher Clean Fuel Bulk Lamp Oil – 5 Gallons – Smokeless/Virtually Odorless – Longer Burning
features: NOT FOR USE IN FIRE PITS OR VESSELS REQUIRING AN ETHANOL-BASED FUEL. Alternative, longer burning fuel than paraffin lamp oil or kerosene - inhouse testing showed a significantly longer burn time. See the REVIEWS. Important: to achieve a smokeless burn, please review the User-Guide PDF which is found under Technical Specifications on this page below. We will send you a tips email detailing best-use practices. Please use as directed and you will have a great experience.

KOSHER, CLEAN BURNING, ODORLESS, SMOKELESS & CLEAR – The base fuel is odorless. We add eucalyptus oil which adds a slight hint of scent when smelling in the bottle – not so much when burning. It’s a nice alternative to citronella oil. Be sure to use a NEW wick and keep the height as low as possible, about 1/16” above the wick holder. Maximum flame will be achieved in about 5 minutes. Also NEVER MIX our fuel with another fuel.

BULK LAMP OIL 5-GALLON CONTAINER WITH SPIGOT: Included with every 5-Gallon container of Firefly Fuel is a spigot for easy refilling. Have it on hand before the next emergency or hurricane hits. This fuel has no shelf life when properly stored. Recommended for indoor and outdoor use.

USE RECOMMENDATIONS: For use in liquid oil candles, oil lamps & hurricane lanterns that use a small wick. Safe for Indoor & outdoor use. Please read the reviews where folks give 1 star. They are not using the fuel as directed. An informed consumer is our best customer. Approved for use with Firefly Colored Lamp Oil Dye

WHERE NOT TO USE - Not for use in table-top fireplaces, effusion lamps or catalytic lamps that require gel fuel or alcohol-based fuels. Firefly CLEAN Lamp Oil is NOT recommended for tiki torches or vessels using a wick larger than 3.6mm which is a little over 1/8” as it will smoke. (See Discussion Below)
description: Buy your lamp oil in bulk. 5 Gallons of Firefly Kosher CLEAN Lamp Oil is now available in a super cool, easily transportable container and includes an easy-pour spigot. Our restaurant and resort customers demanded this product as it is a direct replacement for paraffin lamp oil - spotless, smokeless and virtually odorless. An easy-pour spigot is included. NEVER MIX FUELS as mixing will change burning characteristics.

CLEAN Lamp Oil burns longer than paraffin lamp oil. The fuel will last indefinitely if properly stored in a closed container. We suggest you use it in small-wicked devices such as oil candles, oil lamps and lantern. We DO NOT recommend using this oil in large-wicked vessels like tiki torches as it will smoke. Firefly CLEAN Lamp Oil will perform adequately in Aladdin Magical Mantle Lamps. It will not provide as bright a flame as a 1-k kerosene, Kleen Heat or Aladdin Lamp Oil that have a 141-degree - 145-degree Farenheight flash points. Firefly CLEAN lamp oil was designed specifically to perform best in lanterns with flat wicks and small round-wick candles. The flash point is 220 degrees F.
This fuel can be used indoors our outdoors. Of note, all Firefly Fuels use commercial-style bottles and there are NO inactive ingredients, such as colorants, which reduce purity.
One more thing, our packaging has been tested and approved to ensure the product gets to you in tip-top shape.
